fixedPositionTiming.method: identical saved tactical states: initial turn-start, reconstructed mid/late arena boundaries with recorded next-phase objectives, and complete campaign chapter starts; one own phase per policy

limitations: Priority and Battler share one battle planner; Battler rejects campaigns.
Priority uses full Mixed for essential actors in crisis and for campaigns combining defeat and unrestricted seal objectives; Ashen Oath currently uses full Mixed from chapter one.
Aggregate gains do not establish nonregression for every small battle stratum or faction. All observed strata are included.
Whole-game decision CPU depends on strategy and game duration. The separate saved-position measurement holds tactical input states fixed.
An additional fourfold decision-CPU reduction has not been achieved.

repeatCheck.comparison: repeat reproducibility of the new policy run; not equality with existing-policy gameplay

priorityTournamentTiming.method: Replace Mixed with Priority in both seats of the full tournament; identical grid size and recording, with intentionally different gameplay. Do not compare the new gameplay for equality with existing policies.
